description: This source file defines the TableMenuBar class, a custom menu bar component for a Java Swing application related to a table viewer/editor. It manages menu items for file operations, editing, viewing, and comparison features, and sets up action listeners for interaction within a TableFrame context.

classes.name: TableMenuBar
classes.description: A custom JMenuBar for the application, providing menus for file, edit, view, and comparison operations specific to table management in a Swing interface.

methods.name: TableMenuBar
methods.description: Constructor that initializes menus and applies table-specific rules.

methods.name: initFileMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'File' menu, including graph viewing, comparison, and close options.

methods.name: initEditMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Edit' menu with options like undo, revert, copy, and interpolation.

methods.name: initViewMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'View' menu with properties view options.

methods.name: initCompareMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Compare' submenu with options for comparing tables.

methods.name: initCompareGroup
methods.description: Sets up button groups for comparison options.

methods.name: applyTableTypeRules
methods.description: Adjusts menu item availability based on table type.
